correctness.rationale: Exact scalar reciprocal logistic periodic solution gives mean reciprocal prey=mean inverse capacity. Explicit g second derivative has numerator 3B^2u^2+3BCu+C^2-BD, yielding strict Jensen for nonconstant K when C^2>=BD. For C^2<BD, choose a small reciprocal-prey sinusoid within a strict-concavity interval and set K^-1=u+u_prime/r>0; then Jensen reverses. The rational witnesses were checked. Conclusions concern linear Floquet invasion only.

value.rationale: The coefficient boundary distinguishes when any seasonal variability preserves or improves the rare-predator invasion prospect versus the constant harmonic-capacity reference, from when it can suppress invasion. The counterexample and paired exact benchmarks establish that neither sign is a mere normalization convention; the result is a natural local ecological sensitivity theorem independent of frequency or waveform.
